This page takes you from the smithers.sh home page to a repository's files and issues, then to signing in with GitHub. It takes about five minutes.

**Before you start:** you need a GitHub account to sign in. To open a private repository, you also need read access to it on GitHub.

## 1. Open smithers.sh

Go to [smithers.sh](https://smithers.sh). Choose **Get started for free** to sign in, or open a repository below.

<figure class="docs-shot">
<img src="/images/docs/welcome-home.light.webp" alt="The smithers.sh home page with Get started for free" width="1440" height="900" loading="lazy" decoding="async" class="dark:sl-hidden" />
<img src="/images/docs/welcome-home.dark.webp" alt="The smithers.sh home page with Get started for free" width="1440" height="900" loading="lazy" decoding="async" class="light:sl-hidden" />
</figure>

## 2. Open a repository

A repository on smithers.sh has the path it has on GitHub: replace `github.com` with `smithers.sh` in the repository's address. For example, `https://smithers.sh/smithersai/vibelang` opens the `smithersai/vibelang` repository.

The repository opens on **Home**. Choose **Code** to browse its files and select a branch.

<figure class="docs-shot">
<img src="/images/docs/quickstart-repo-home.light.webp" alt="The smithersai/vibelang repository on its Home tab" width="1440" height="900" loading="lazy" decoding="async" class="dark:sl-hidden" />
<img src="/images/docs/quickstart-repo-home.dark.webp" alt="The smithersai/vibelang repository on its Home tab" width="1440" height="900" loading="lazy" decoding="async" class="light:sl-hidden" />
</figure>

A repository not yet cloned offers **Sign in to clone**. A missing or inaccessible repository shows **Not found**; a failed lookup shows an error.

## 3. Read a file

Choose **Code**, then a folder to open it, or a file to read it. The file's path is at the top. Choose the repository's name in the path to go back to its files.

<figure class="docs-shot">
<img src="/images/docs/quickstart-file.light.webp" alt="package.json in smithersai/vibelang on smithers.sh, with the file's path at the top (1)" width="1440" height="900" loading="lazy" decoding="async" class="dark:sl-hidden" />
<img src="/images/docs/quickstart-file.dark.webp" alt="package.json in smithersai/vibelang on smithers.sh, with the file's path at the top (1)" width="1440" height="900" loading="lazy" decoding="async" class="light:sl-hidden" />
</figure>

## 4. Read issues and pull requests

Choose **Issues** to list the repository's open and closed issues, or **Pull requests** to list its pull requests. Choose an issue to read it.

<figure class="docs-shot">
<img src="/images/docs/quickstart-issues.light.webp" alt="The Issues tab of smithersai/vibelang on smithers.sh: Issues (1) and Pull requests (2), with each issue's author hidden" width="1440" height="900" loading="lazy" decoding="async" class="dark:sl-hidden" />
<img src="/images/docs/quickstart-issues.dark.webp" alt="The Issues tab of smithersai/vibelang on smithers.sh: Issues (1) and Pull requests (2), with each issue's author hidden" width="1440" height="900" loading="lazy" decoding="async" class="light:sl-hidden" />
</figure>

## 5. Sign in with GitHub

From the home page, choose **Get started for free**. GitHub asks you to sign in, then to authorize Smithers to read your account and email address and to access your repositories.

<figure class="docs-shot">
<img src="/images/docs/quickstart-sign-in.light.webp" alt="GitHub's sign-in page, opened from Sign in on smithers.sh" width="1440" height="900" loading="lazy" decoding="async" class="dark:sl-hidden" />
<img src="/images/docs/quickstart-sign-in.dark.webp" alt="GitHub's sign-in page, opened from Sign in on smithers.sh" width="1440" height="900" loading="lazy" decoding="async" class="light:sl-hidden" />
</figure>

## Result

You opened a repository on smithers.sh, read a file, listed its issues, and started signing in with GitHub.
